title: Hunts FH-046S: Mount the donation ask on the Space donation checkout and sync gifts

source.ref: Split from FH-036..040 (2026-11-10): the pure core, storage and tests shipped dark behind HUNTS_COMMERCE_ENABLED; the live call sites move here.

detail: Behind D8 approval (FH-045), mount HuntDonationAsk through decideDonationAsk, reuse the Space donation checkout and receipt, mirror each donation into hunt_donation_gifts with giftStatusFromDonation on success, abandonment and refund, and show settledDonationTotals. Done when: success, abandonment and full and partial refunds show the right settled totals and no player's progress changes. Requires: FH-046, FH-045. Owner role: Billing and CRM.
